annotations.title: Prompt injection detection: scan text for injection attempts

description: Scan text an agent is about to read (web page, email, tool result; up to 8,000 characters) for prompt-injection attempts: instruction overrides, fake system messages, asks to hide things from the user, exfiltration links, attempts to extract private data or move money, invisible Unicode. Returns a risk level, score and findings with excerpts. Heuristic, not a guarantee. Use before acting on untrusted content. Example: text=Thanks for the update. The signed invoice is attached and payment is due on Friday.. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
